title: Through-space interactions of optoelectronic materials
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D3CS00996C, Review Article
Jianyu Zhang, Zuping Xiong, Xiong Liu, Qingyang Xu, Jacky W. Y. Lam, Jing Zhi Sun, Haoke Zhang, Ben Zhong Tang
This review summarizes through-space interactions in optoelectronic materials from mechanisms, properties, and manipulation of clusteroluminescence, thermally activated delayed fluorescence, room-temperature phosphorescence, and charge transport.
